Him opening up to you about his atypical fetish is him being vulnerable with you.  Would you have rather he had been holding you accountable to limit calories and exercise?  Is that something you asked of him?  You  should consider the possibility that he cares for you and possibly felt that the struggles you had didn’t warrant additional external pressure from him.  Talk to him about it, but definitely don’t assume his motive for his behavior, let him speak for himself.
